info.name: UnderCover API
info.description: The UnderCover backend's API. Pick the UnderCover local environment, fill in supabaseUrl, supabasePublishableKey and handlerPassword from your .env, start the backend with `npm run dev`, then send a request or run the whole collection. Before each request the collection signs in as Dana Whitfield and Marcus Oyelaran through Supabase Auth's password grant, once an hour, and handler actions carry their access tokens.

request.description: `record_model_call`: refused on a claim nobody has started.
`list_steps`: the steps in order.
`decide_claim`: an approval at or under $1,000 stays in progress until it is paid.
`pay_claim`: pays the approved payout.
`pay_claim`: the same payment again, as after a restart, is done: it returns the claim, paid once.
`pay_claim`: a different amount on a paid claim is refused.
`decide_claim`: the same decision again, as after a restart, is done: it returns the claim with one decision.
`list_claims` carries each claim's latest decision, payout and payment.
`start_claim`: start a waiting claim in the run.
`decide_claim`: an approval over $1,000 waits for sign-off.
`pay_claim` is refused over $1,000, even if the agent tries.

exec: pm.test("refused", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("A payout over $1,000.00 waits for a handler's sign-off"));

item.name: Sign off CLM-1002 as Dana Whitfield

request.description: `review_payout`: a handler signs off the held payout. The claim goes back in progress for the agent to pay, and the backend asks the agent's service to pick it up.

exec: pm.test("back in progress for the agent", () => pm.expect(["in_progress", "decided"]).to.include(claim.status));
pm.test("signed off by Dana Whitfield", () => { const d = claim.decisions[claim.decisions.length - 1]; pm.expect(d.review).to.eql("signed_off"); pm.expect(d.reviewed_by).to.eql("HND-01"); });

request.description: `pay_claim`: the agent pays the signed-off payout, and the payment records the sign-off. If the agent's service paid it first, the same payment is a repeat and returns the claim.

exec: pm.test("authorized by Dana Whitfield, with the sign-off's time", () => { pm.expect(claim.payment.authorized_by).to.eql("HND-01"); pm.expect(claim.payment.signed_off_at).to.be.a("string"); });
